    input start,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output reg mosi,

    output reg cs,
    output reg done
);

        sclk <= 0;

    input wire K,
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    output reg Q
);

            Q <= 0;
        end else begin
            case ({J, K})
                2'b00: Q <= Q;       // No change
                2'b01: Q <= 0;       // Reset
                2'b10: Q <= 1;       // Set
                2'b11: Q <= ~Q;      // Toggle
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
